sources.title: Invoice prepayments (en-US)
sources.appliesTo: Business Central documentation, en-US; checked 2026-09-26
fields: Vendor prepayments are invoiced and posted on purchase orders before the final invoice; distinguish the advance invoice from payment settlement
Configure prepayment posting accounts, number series, and default percentages for vendors and items; verify the purchase posting setup
Adjust order-level or line-level prepayment amounts and review additional prepayment invoices after quantity or line changes
A purchase line with an invoiced prepayment requires a prepayment credit memo before deletion
Review prepayment application and final invoice balances; invoice posting does not prove vendor payment
